description: This Swift file defines the `OpenClawChatView` SwiftUI view component for a chat interface, including various subviews and utilities for rendering messages, handling state changes, and displaying different UI banners and overlays.

classes.name: OpenClawChatView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that implements a chat interface with message rendering, scrolling, and state management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the OpenClawChatView with a view model and configuration parameters.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main UI layout and behavior of the chat view.

methods.name: messageList
methods.description: Constructs the scrollable list of chat messages with support for auto-scrolling and overlays.

methods.name: messageListRows
methods.description: Generates individual message bubbles and auxiliary indicators for the message list.

methods.name: mergeToolResults
methods.description: Merges consecutive tool result messages for display.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Checks whether a message is a tool result based on its role.

methods.name: shouldDisplayMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message should be visible based on content and role.

methods.name: primaryText
methods.description: Extracts the main textual content from a message.

methods.name: hasInlineAttachments
methods.description: Checks if a message contains inline file or attachment content.

methods.name: toolCalls
methods.description: Filters content items indicating tool calls.

methods.name: inlineToolResults
methods.description: Filters content items indicating inline tool results.

methods.name: toolCallIds
methods.description: Collects all related IDs associated with tool calls in a message.

methods.name: toolResultText
methods.description: Returns textual content for a tool result message.

methods.name: dismissKeyboardIfNeeded
methods.description: Dismisses the keyboard on iOS/tvOS when tapped outside input.
